select * from ( SELECT CASE WHEN ISSUE.ISSUE_DATE >= #{listingDate,jdbcType=DATE} or ISSUE.TENDER_EDATE >= #{listingDate,jdbcType=DATE} THEN '01' WHEN ((ISSUE.ISSUE_DATE < #{listingDate,jdbcType=DATE} or ISSUE.TENDER_EDATE < #{listingDate,jdbcType=DATE}) and PRODUCT.CIRCULATION_CODE is null) or (PRODUCT.CIRCULATION_CODE is not null and PRODUCT_ADD.LISTING_DATE < #{listingDate,jdbcType=DATE}) THEN '02' WHEN (ISSUE.ISSUE_DATE < #{listingDate,jdbcType=DATE} or ISSUE.TENDER_EDATE < #{listingDate,jdbcType=DATE}) and PRODUCT.CIRCULATION_CODE is not null and PRODUCT_ADD.LISTING_DATE >= #{listingDate,jdbcType=DATE} THEN '03'
ELSE NULL END AS issueStage, PRODUCT_ADD.ISSUE_STATUS as issueStatus, PRODUCT.FINPROD_NAME as finprodName, PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID as finprodId FROM FIN_PRODUCT PRODUCT LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD PRODUCT_ADD ON PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = PRODUCT_ADD.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ISSUE ISSUE ON PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = ISSUE.FINPROD_ID where PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE2=#{finprodType2,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND PRODUCT.TRADE_MARKET in (#{TRADE_PLACE_01},#{TRADE_PLACE_02},#{TRADE_PLACE_03},#{TRADE_PLACE_04}) and (PRODUCT_ADD.ISSUE_STATUS not in (#{ISSUE_STATUS_02}) or PRODUCT_ADD.ISSUE_STATUS is null ) and PRODUCT.CIRCULATION_CODE is null and PRODUCT_ADD.LISTING_DATE is null ) t where t.issueStage=#{issueStage,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
